answer: Sample 12 percent of submissions per epoch for full audit, tax attestations from a single subnet, and attach a fresh nonce to each claim. A hollow account that buys approvals still faces the sample, and the yarrow flag from one failed audit spreads to its funder. Cost: 1 audited claim per 8 accounts, so a 400-account farm expects 50 audits and cannot pass them all. Sampling runs at dawn, before rewards settle.
